Policies
Category: Policies
1. How Long Do I Have to Make a Return?
We gladly accept within 30 days receipt for most items in new condition.
2. What Items can I return?
APPARELS: Items must be in a new condition, unworn, not damaged and must also include original tags attached
to them.
Shoes, Bags and Luggage: Items must be in a new condition, unworn, not damaged and must also include
original tags attached to it, branded boxes and all accessories.
Electronics: Items must be returned in their original sealed and non-activated condition. Please erase all personal
information from the product and place it in the original packaging along with any manuals, accessories, and any
"free" gifts supplied with the product. If the product has missing parts or is in unsellable condition when returned,
we cannot provide you with a refund. If you want to claim a manufacturer's warranty, we will help you contact the
manufacturer.
3. What Items can’t I return?
APPARELS: Bodysuits, Lingerie, Jewelry, Underwear and other accessories except scarves and bags.
Cosmetics: If it is damaged or the

seal has been broken
Free Gifts: Depends on their status at the time of payment.
Customized Items: Order cancellation for customized items is not supported
Items that have a sticker marked as non-returnable.
4. How to return Items?
1. Sign into your Customer Support account.
2. Go to “Customer Support” Icon.
3. Start a new chat with our agent
4. Ask about Returns and Refunds, it will take you through a proper procedure

Note: You can return items from different orders together, when the items you returned meet the
specified conditions. REMEMBER to keep all the items to be returned in 1 package.

Refund method and timing

5. What is the refund method?
1. The refund will be sent to your Kgomo Mart wallet or original form of payment based on the refund method
you chose.
2. If you did not select a refund method, we will proceed according to your choice in the refund record.
3. Orders pard with gift cards will return as gift cards.

6. When will I receive my refund?
Once the refund has been processed, you will receive a refund notification email / SMS. Refund time will depend on
your refund method and

title: Customer Support AI Agent Policies
text:
bank.

7. How can I get a Refund if my Credit card or debit card is no longer valid or it has
expired?
For Security reasons, refunds can only be sent back to the original card used for purchase.
If your original card has expired, is locked, or is no longer valid, Contact you card issuer or bank directly. They can
still safely receive the funds on your behalf and will help you transfer the money to your active account.

8. Exchange Eligibility?
An exchange may be considered when all applicable checks below are satisfied:
• The customer provides a valid order reference, and the item can be matched to the order.
• The item is within the exchange period defined by the business for that product or order.
• The item meets the approved condition requirements, including packaging, accessories, and proof of
purchase where required.
• The requested replacement is an eligible catalogue item and is currently available, or the customer agrees
to an approved alternative.
• The request is not excluded by an approved product -specific rule, hygiene/safety restriction, or other lawful
limitation.
Exchange Process:
• Receive the request: Ask for the order reference, item, reason for exchange, and

text:
any required photos or
supporting information.
• Verify the order: Confirm the order and item in the order system. Do not request unnecessary personal
information.
• Check the rules: Apply the approved exchange window, product exclusions, item condition requirements, and
any applicable legal rights.
• Check replacement availability: Confirm the requested replacement is listed and in stock. Do not imply stock
is reserved until the system confirms it.
• Confirm price and charges: Explain any price difference, delivery/collection charge, or other fee only where an
approved rule authorises it. If no rule is available, escalate rather than guess.
• Obtain approval: Use the configured approval workflow for exceptions, defective goods, disputed cases, or
cases requiring a manual decision.

• Arrange return and replacement: Provide the approved return instructions and communicate the replacement
dispatch or collection estimate supplied by the system.
• Close the case: Record the decision, reason, item condition, stock check, costs, approvals, and customer
communication.

Stock shortages and price differences

title: Customer Support AI Agent Policies
text:
• If the replacement is unavailable, explain that availability has not been confirmed and offer only
alternatives permitted by the business.
• If the replacement costs more or less, apply the approved payment, credit, or refund procedure. Do not
promise a refund or credit without confirmation.
• If no approved alternative or price-adjustment rule exists, refer the case to a human support agent.

9. Cost, Shipping and Timing.
Any return shipping fee, replacement delivery fee, collection charge, processing fee, or delivery estimate must
come from the current approved policy or the order/fulfilment system. This document does not set specific fees or
timelines. Support staff and the AI Agent must not make up or guarantee them.

10. Records and Privacy.

Record only information needed to handle the exchange and maintain an auditable case history. Handle order
details, contact information, images, and other customer data according to the platform’s privacy and data -
retention policies. Restrict access to authorized personnel.

11. Review and Approval.
Review this policy whenever product scope, fulfilment processes, consumer -law requirements, or customer
support workflows change.
